categories.title: Camp
categories.info: Visit camps to save your game, play music purchase items, unlock skills, and restore Tumbler charges. Some camps also allow you to fast travel and upgrade gear.

categories.title: Drone Upgrade Module
categories.info: Drone Upgrade Modules are used to unlock new drone upgrades at a repair console.

categories.title: Gear
categories.info: Gear effects are unlocked by finding other instances of that gear.

categories.title: Tumbler Expansion Module
categories.info: Tumbler Expansion Modules are used as an upgrade material for the Rechargeable Tumbler.

categories.title: Weapon Core
categories.info: Weapon Cores are used to enhance your attack power.

locations.title: Ambush [5 Waves]
locations.description:
Begins when you step onto the glass floor.

**Wave 1:**
- 3x Creeper

**Wave 2:**
- 2x Infector

**Wave 3:**
- 2x Test Subject
- 1x Infector

**Wave 4:**
- Mutated Defiler

**Final Wave:**
- Defiler

locations.title: Laser Panel #1
locations.description:
The first of two panels you need to activate to begin the laser puzzle on the floor below.

The other panel can be found [here](#loc=463884). Use the [Bridge Panel](#loc=463881) to reach it.

locations.title: Bridge Panel #1
locations.description: Use the panel here to lower a bridge and reach the other side of the walkway.

locations.title: Locked Door
locations.description: Opens when you use [Laser Panel #1](#loc=463879)

locations.title: Laser Panel #2
locations.description:
The second of two panels you need to activate to begin the laser puzzle on the floor below.

The other panel can be found [here](#loc=463879).

_Tip: Use the [Ammo Replenisher](#loc=463874) before you use this panel, as several enemies will spawn immediately afterwards!_

locations.title: Bridge Panel #2
locations.description:
Use the panel here to lower a bridge and reach the other side of the walkway.

Only works after activating [Laser Panel #2](#loc=463884).

locations.title: Laser Reflector #1
locations.description:
After activating [Laser Panel #2](#loc=463884), you'll find the first reflector next to the laser.

Move and rotate it so the laser is sent towards the southern wall, but be careful not to aim at specimen tanks for too long - the Infectors in them are alive!

locations.title: Laser Reflector #2
locations.description:
Directly left of the Fusion Cell generator.

After reflecting the laser with [Laser Reflector #1](#loc=463892), move this reflector into its path so the laser goes to the eastern wall.

locations.title: Laser Reflector #3
locations.description:
Hidden among the specimen tanks a short distance south-west from the entrance door.

After redirecting the laser with [Laser Reflector #2](#loc=463893), push this reflector in its way so the laser is sent towards the northern wall.

locations.title: Laser Reflector #4
locations.description:
A few steps in front of the entrance door.

With the laser pointing at the northern wall thanks to [Laser Reflector #3](#loc=463895), your final task is to reflect it towards the small round machine in front of the large generator.

locations.title: Ammo Replenisher
locations.description: Next to the [Camp](#loc=463839)

locations.title: Password-Protected Door

Its password (**μηλαμη**) can be found on the corpse [here](#loc=463902).
